{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now calculate the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = data_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
total_patients = len(data_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

# Print results
print(f"Total deduplicated patients: {total_patients}")
print(f"Number with severe baseline disease: {severe_count}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
